title: The Intercepted ROT13 Telegram
description:
An anonymous telegram was delivered to Scotland Yard.
The text was encoded using ROT13 cipher substitution.
question:
Decode the text:

GUR CBVFBS VF VA GUR JVAR
acceptable_answer_format:
Type the decoded sentence exactly.

Example:
THE KEY IS SAFE
accepted_answers: THE POISON IS IN THE WINE
the poison is in the wine
hints: ROT13 shifts every letter by exactly 13 places in the alphabet.
G shifted by 13 positions becomes T, U becomes H, R becomes E.
Replace each letter with its alphabet midpoint twin to read the warning.
solution_explanation: Applying ROT13 (shifting by 13 letters) to 'GUR CBVFBS VF VA GUR JVAR' yields 'THE POISON IS IN THE WINE'.
